dashboard.name: Daily Split · content calendar and sharing
dashboard.description: First eligible completion to native handoff or copy per browser and challenge. Compare base glasses, named visual themes and holiday campaigns. Same local challenge date, ordered within 24h; partial cohorts are marked. Rates weight browser-challenge counts. The event scan defaults to 90 days in UTC.

insights.name: Daily Split · share conversion by challenge
insights.description: Browser × challenge conversion: first daily counts=true, new_record=true completion → native handoff or copy after completion, within 24h, on the same local challenge date. Repeat shares count once. Attribution uses completion properties. Rates weight browser-challenge finishers; partial_finishers have an open 24h window. Dates follow challenges; event scan defaults to 90 days.

source.query:
SELECT
    challenge_date AS challenge_date,
    theme AS theme,
    glass_id AS glass_id,
    vessel AS vessel,
    scene AS scene,
    visual_theme AS visual_theme,
    campaign_id AS campaign_id,
    campaign_day AS campaign_day,
    schedule_version AS schedule_version,
    count() AS finishers,
    countIf(converted) AS converters,
    1.0 * countIf(converted) / nullIf(count(), 0) AS share_rate,
    countIf(partial_cohort) AS partial_finishers,
    24 AS window_hours
FROM (
    SELECT
        browser_id AS browser_id,
        challenge_date AS challenge_date,
        theme AS theme,
        glass_id AS glass_id,
        vessel AS vessel,
        scene AS scene,
        visual_theme AS visual_theme,
        campaign_id AS campaign_id,
        campaign_day AS campaign_day,
        schedule_version AS schedule_version,
        arrayExists(shared_at -> shared_at > completed_at
            AND shared_at <= addHours(completed_at, 24), successful_share_times) AS converted,
        addHours(completed_at, 24) > now() AS partial_cohort
    FROM (
        SELECT
            distinct_id AS browser_id,
            toString(toDate(properties.challenge_date)) AS challenge_date,
            countIf(event = 'sip_completed' AND properties.new_record = true) AS eligible_completions,
            minIf(timestamp, event = 'sip_completed' AND properties.new_record = true) AS completed_at,
            argMinIf(coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.theme), ''), 'Unknown'), timestamp, event = 'sip_completed' AND properties.new_record = true) AS theme,
            argMinIf(coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.glass_id), ''), CASE
                WHEN properties.theme = 'pub' THEN 'pub'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'beach' THEN 'beach'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'munich' THEN 'munich'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'sapporo' THEN 'sapporo'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'butterbeer' THEN 'butterbeer'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'peroni' THEN 'peroni'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'lager' THEN 'lager'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'pale' THEN 'pale'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'cider' THEN 'cider'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'red' THEN 'red'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'coffee' THEN 'coffee'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'choc' THEN 'choc'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'matcha' THEN 'matcha'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'cola' THEN 'cola'
                ELSE 'Unknown'
            END), timestamp, event = 'sip_completed' AND properties.new_record = true) AS glass_id,
            argMinIf(coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.vessel), ''), CASE
                WHEN properties.theme = 'pub' THEN 'tulip'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'beach' THEN 'bottle'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'munich' THEN 'stein'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'sapporo' THEN 'tall'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'butterbeer' THEN 'tulip'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'peroni' THEN 'tall'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'lager' THEN 'nonic'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'pale' THEN 'tumbler'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'cider' THEN 'tulip'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'red' THEN 'nonic'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'coffee' THEN 'cup'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'choc' THEN 'mug'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'matcha' THEN 'tumbler'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'cola' THEN 'tall'
                ELSE 'Unknown'
            END), timestamp, event = 'sip_completed' AND properties.new_record = true) AS vessel,
            argMinIf(coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.scene), ''), CASE
                WHEN properties.theme = 'pub' THEN 'pub'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'beach' THEN 'beach'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'munich' THEN 'munich'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'sapporo' THEN 'tokyo'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'butterbeer' THEN 'hogsmeade'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'peroni' THEN 'rome'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'lager' THEN 'bar'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'pale' THEN 'bar'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'cider' THEN 'bar'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'red' THEN 'bar'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'coffee' THEN 'bar'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'choc' THEN 'bar'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'matcha' THEN 'bar'
                WHEN properties.theme = 'cola' THEN 'bar'
                ELSE 'Unknown'
            END), timestamp, event = 'sip_completed' AND properties.new_record = true) AS scene,
            argMinIf(coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.visual_theme), ''), 'Unknown'), timestamp, event = 'sip_completed' AND properties.new_record = true) AS visual_theme,
            argMinIf(coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.campaign_id), ''), 'none'), timestamp, event = 'sip_completed' AND properties.new_record = true) AS campaign_id,
            argMinIf(coalesce(toInt(properties.campaign_day), 0), timestamp, event = 'sip_completed' AND properties.new_record = true) AS campaign_day,
            argMinIf(coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.schedule_version), ''), 'Unknown'), timestamp, event = 'sip_completed' AND properties.new_record = true) AS schedule_version,
            groupArrayIf(timestamp,
                event IN ('result_shared', 'result_copied')
                AND properties.local_play_date = properties.challenge_date
            ) AS successful_share_times
        FROM events
        WHERE event IN ('sip_completed', 'result_shared', 'result_copied')
            AND properties.attempt_kind = 'daily'
            AND properties.counts = true
            AND properties.challenge_date IS NOT NULL
            AND toString(properties.challenge_date) != ''
            AND {filters}
        GROUP BY browser_id, challenge_date
    )
    WHERE eligible_completions > 0
)
GROUP BY challenge_date, theme, glass_id, vessel, scene, visual_theme, campaign_id, campaign_day, schedule_version
ORDER BY challenge_date DESC, theme ASC
LIMIT 500
